title: Future Continuous
intro:
Future continuous: will be + kata kerja -ing. Untuk kegiatan yang akan sedang berlangsung pada waktu tertentu di masa depan.
At 8 tonight I will be studying.
They will be travelling next week.

exercises.question: At 8 tonight I ___ dinner.
exercises.explanation: Rumusnya will be + kata kerja -ing: will be cooking.

exercises.question: She ___ at the office tomorrow morning.
exercises.explanation: Will be + working. Will tidak pernah mendapat -s.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence with the future continuous
exercises.explanation: Will be + kata kerja -ing: will be playing.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence with the future continuous
exercises.sentence: We ___ (wait) for you at the station.
exercises.explanation: Will be + waiting, sama untuk semua subjek.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order
exercises.answer: I will be sleeping at midnight
exercises.explanation: Subjek + will be + kata kerja -ing + keterangan waktu.

exercises.prompt: Match each tense to its formula
exercises.explanation: Future continuous menambahkan be di antara will dan kata kerja -ing, berbeda dari simple future yang memakai bentuk dasar.

exercises.question: Pick the correct future continuous sentence.
exercises.explanation: Rumusnya lengkap: will + be + kata kerja -ing.

answer: She will be reading a book.
exercises.explanation: Present continuous jadi future continuous: is berubah menjadi will be.

exercises.task: Write one sentence about what you will be doing tonight.
exercises.modelAnswer: I will be watching a movie tonight.
exercises.explanation: Gunakan will be + kata kerja -ing, misalnya 'I will be watching a movie tonight.'
